comingSoon.body: This part of {{appName}} already works in the mobile app and is on its way to the web. Until it lands here, use the app on your phone.

noAccess.title: Not part of your role
noAccess.body: Your role in this business does not include this page. If you need it, ask an owner or an admin.
noAccess.planBody: This business's plan does not include this page. The business's owner can change the plan.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address. The link may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.

notifications.browserNote: This browser does not pop notifications up yet — they arrive in the bell at the top of the page.

location.denied: This browser is blocking location for this site. Allow it from the icon beside the address, then try again.

workCalendar.removeBody: {{date}} becomes an ordinary working day again, and payroll counts it as one.
workCalendar.oneWorkingDay: At least one day a week has to be a working day, or payroll would have nothing to divide by.

upload.pick: Choose a CSV or Excel file, or drop it here
upload.pickChange: Click, or drop another file, to change it
upload.wrongType: That is not a CSV or Excel file. Choose a .csv or .xlsx file.
upload.tooLarge: That file is larger than 5 MB. Split it into smaller files — a month or two each.

plan.contact: To change the plan or pay for more branches, write to
